strategies.name: aim
strategies.description: AIM strategy compiled to a WASM module for the strategy-worker. Vendor-published, installed into the customer DB as a versioned binary.

strategies.name: bs
strategies.description: BS (buy_sell) bidirectional grid strategy compiled to a WASM module for the strategy-worker. Vendor-published, installed into the customer DB as a versioned binary.

strategies.name: mtf-rsi
strategies.description: Multi-timeframe RSI strategy compiled to a WASM module for the strategy-worker. HTF RSI trend filter + LTF RSI snap-back entry, reversing on the opposite signal.

strategies.name: rsi
strategies.description: Single-timeframe RSI crossing strategy compiled to a WASM module. Buys when RSI crosses up through oversold, sells when it crosses down through overbought; only ever opens (no close/offset).

strategies.name: rsi-bb
strategies.description: RSI + Bollinger Band crossing strategy compiled to a WASM module. Buys when RSI crosses up through oversold and price touches/breaches the lower band; sells when RSI crosses down through overbought and price touches/breaches the upper band. Only ever opens (no close/offset).

strategies.name: stochastic
strategies.description: Single-timeframe slow-stochastic crossing strategy compiled to a WASM module. Buys when %D crosses up through oversold, sells when it crosses down through overbought; only ever opens (no close/offset).

strategies.name: stochastic
strategies.description: Single-timeframe slow-stochastic crossing strategy compiled to a WASM module. Buys when %D crosses up through oversold, sells when it crosses down through overbought; only ever opens (no close/offset). Per-signal size is a percent of capital (default 5%) or a fixed dollar amount.

strategies.description: Single-timeframe slow-stochastic crossing strategy compiled to a WASM module. Buys when %D crosses up through oversold, sells when it crosses down through overbought; only ever opens (no close/offset). Per-signal size is a percent of remaining cash (default 5%) or a fixed dollar amount.
